about.title: Guraben karatu da ayyukan yi, sun dace da dalilai.
about.lede: An gina shi don mutanen da suka gaji da gungurawa jeneriki allo. Shigar da abin da kuka karanta da abin da za ku iya yi - mun ba da matsayi na buɗewa kuma mu faɗi dalilin da yasa suka dace.
about.ideaTitle: Matching yakamata ya zama kamar taƙaitaccen bayani, ba jujjuya hanyoyin haɗin gwiwa ba.
about.ideaBody1: Injin bincike da allunan dama suna nuna girma. Ba safai suke sanin digirin Kimiyyar Kwamfuta, ƙwarewar React ɗinku, ko kuma cewa kuna nema daga Botswana - kuma kusan ba su taɓa yin bayanin dacewa ba.
about.ideaBody2: Opportunistic yana kiyaye bayanin martaba guda ɗaya kuma yana gudanar da scholarship da aiki daidai da shi. Kowane sakamako yana ɗaukar maki, tushe, da dalilin da za ku iya amfani da shi a zahiri.

privacyBody.overview: Opportunistic ("mu") yana ba da tallafin karatu da daidaita aikin. Wannan manufar tana bayanin abin da muke tattarawa, dalilin da yasa, tsawon lokacin da muke kiyaye shi, da haƙƙin ku. Muna amfani da tushen tushen GDPR ga kowane mai amfani a duk duniya, kuma muna mutunta ƙaƙƙarfan ƙa'idodin gida inda suke aiki (ciki har da UK GDPR, POPIA a Afirka ta Kudu, da makamantan tsarin). Wannan jagorar yarda ce mai amfani don samfurinmu - ba shawarar doka ta yau da kullun don ikon ku ba.
privacyBody.lawfulContractDesc: Ƙirƙirar asusunku, daidaitawa, da isar da sabis ɗin da kuke buƙata
privacyBody.lawfulLegitimateDesc: Tsaro, rigakafin cin zarafi, amincin sabis - daidaitacce da haƙƙin ku
privacyBody.lawfulLegalDesc: Inda dole ne mu riƙe ko bayyana bayanai a ƙarƙashin doka da ta dace
privacyBody.storeAccountDesc: Imel da takaddun shaida ta Supabase Auth
privacyBody.storeProfileDesc: Suna, ƙasa, kanun labarai, tarihin rayuwa, cancanta, da ƙwarewar da kuka shigar
privacyBody.storeMatchesDesc: Take, URL, tushen, dalili, maki, da ajiye/kore jihar
privacyBody.storeTechnicalDesc: Kuki yarda, kukis ɗin zaman da ake buƙata don shiga, ƙididdigar zaɓi idan kun ƙyale su
privacyBody.cookiesIntro: Muna amfani da kuki mai izini (opp_consent) don tunawa da zaɓinku har tsawon watanni 12. Kukis masu buƙata suna kiyaye amincin amincin. Zaɓuɓɓuka, nazari, da cookies ɗin tallace-tallace suna ɗauka kawai bayan ka shiga. Kuna iya canza tunanin ku kowane lokaci.
privacyBody.cookiesNecessaryDesc: Tabbataccen zaman, tsaro, adana wannan yarda
privacyBody.cookiesPreferencesDesc: Ƙwaƙwalwar UI na zaɓi fiye da yarda
privacyBody.cookiesAnalyticsDesc: Ma'aunin amfani - an toshe rubutun har sai an ba da izini
privacyBody.cookiesMarketingDesc: Ad/sake tallan tags - an toshe rubutun har sai an ba da izini
privacyBody.cookiesOrFooter: - ko amfani da saitunan kuki a cikin ƙafar ƙafa.
privacyBody.useBody: Bayanin bayanan ku yana da ikon daidaitawa da shawarwari masu ma'ana. Ba mu sayar da bayanan sirri. Ba ma amfani da cancantar ku don gina bayanan talla sai dai idan kun ba da izinin kukis ɗin tallace-tallace a sarari kuma an bayyana abokin talla na gaba anan.
privacyBody.transfersBody: Kayan aiki na iya sarrafa bayanai a yankunan da masu samar da mu ke amfani da su (misali Supabase da Brevo). Inda bayanai suka fita daga ƙasarku, muna dogara da ingantattun kariyar da aka gane ƙarƙashin ka'idojin salon GDPR (kamar daidaitattun sassan kwangilar da waɗancan masu samarwa suka bayar) kuma muna rage abin da muke adanawa.
privacyBody.retentionBody: Asusu da bayanan wasa suna tsayawa yayin da asusun ku ke aiki. Idan kun share bayananku a cikin Saituna, muna cire bayanan martaba, cancanta, ƙwarewa, matches, da tarihin bincike daga bayanan ƙa'idar. Hakanan za'a iya buƙatar tsaftace-asusu a hello@opportunistic.online. Ana iya adana bayanan yarda a matsayin shaidar zaɓi har tsawon rayuwar kuki ko kamar yadda doka ta buƙata.
privacyBody.rightsBody: Dangane da inda kuke zama, kuna iya samun haƙƙoƙin shiga, gyara, sharewa, taƙaitawa, abu, bayanan tashar jiragen ruwa, da janye izini. Muna girmama waɗannan a matsayin tushen tushen duniya. Kuna iya shirya bayanin martabarku kowane lokaci kuma ku share bayananku daga Saituna.
privacyBody.childrenBody: Opportunistic ba a ba da umarni ga yara masu ƙasa da 16 (ko mafi girman shekarun yarda na dijital a cikin ƙasarku). Kada ku ƙirƙiri asusu idan kun kasance ƙasa da wannan shekarun. Idan muka koyi muna riƙe irin waɗannan bayanan, za mu share su.
privacyBody.sharingBody: Muna raba bayanai tare da na'urori masu sarrafawa waɗanda ke taimakawa gudanar da sabis: Supabase (auth/database), Brevo (imel ɗin ma'amala lokacin da aka kunna), da kuma ɗaukar hoto (Shafukan GitHub). Lissafi suna buɗewa akan rukunin yanar gizo na ɓangare na uku tare da manufofinsu. Ba mu sayar da bayanan sirri.

termsBody.roleBody: Opportunistic dandalin ganowa ne. Muna fitar da tallafin karatu na ɓangare na uku da jerin ayyukan aiki bisa bayanin martabarku. Ba mu ne mai bayarwa, mai aiki, ko mai ba da duk wata dama da aka nuna akan rukunin yanar gizon ba.
termsBody.roleCallout: Koyaushe gama aikace-aikace akan jeri na tushen hukuma. Opportunistic ya bayyana dacewa; tushen ya mallaki cancanta da sakamako.
termsBody.accuracyBody: Lissafi na iya zama daɗaɗɗen bayan ƙididdigewa. Koyaushe tabbatar da cancanta, ƙayyadaddun ƙayyadaddun ƙayyadaddun lokaci, da matakan aikace-aikacen akan gidan yanar gizon tushen kafin nema. Makin matches, tunani, da tukwici shawarwari ne - ba su da garantin karɓa, kuɗi, ko aiki ba.
termsBody.accountAccuracyDesc: Kuna da alhakin gaskiyar bayanin da kuka gabatar
termsBody.accountOthersDesc: Kar a loda bayanan sirri na wani ba tare da izini ba
termsBody.accountFairDesc: Za mu iya dakatar da asusun da ke cin zarafin daidaitawa ko ƙoƙarin soke sabis ɗin
termsBody.liabilityBody: Har zuwa iyakar abin da doka ta ba da izini, Opportunistic ba ta da alhakin yanke shawara da aka yi dangane da jerin abubuwan da aka bayyana, gami da rufaffiyar damar, abun ciki na ɓangare na uku, ko aikace-aikacen da ba su yi nasara ba.
termsBody.privacyAfter: ya bayyana abin da muke tattarawa da kuma haƙƙoƙin ku. Kukis na zaɓi da makamantan fasahohin suna ɗauka ne kawai bayan kun yarda ta banner kuki ko saitunan kuki. Kukis ɗin da ake buƙata don tsaro, shiga, da tunawa cewa zaɓin ya ci gaba da kasancewa. Duba
termsBody.changesBody: Za mu iya sabunta waɗannan sharuɗɗan yayin da samfurin ke tasowa. Kwanan da aka sabunta a saman wannan shafin yana nuna sabon bita. Ci gaba da amfani bayan canje-canje yana nufin ka karɓi sharuɗɗan da aka sabunta.

tips.sLeadership: Rubuta labarin jagoranci mai kalmomi 150 wanda ya fara a cikin {{place}} kuma ya ƙare da yadda lambar yabo ta {{source}} ke ninka wannan tasirin.
tips.sModules: Taswirar {{field}} bayanan ku zuwa kayayyaki 3 akan shirin {{location}} manufa - suna suna a cikin bayanan sirrinku.
tips.sEssaySkills: A cikin muqala ta 1, keɓe sakin layi ɗaya ga yadda {{skills}} ya riga ya samar da sakamako mai iya aunawa (lambobi sun doke sifa).
tips.sAdvanced: Jagoranci tare da zurfin {{skill}} ({{level}}) a matsayin hujja za ku iya ɗaukar ƙarfi {{intensity}}.
tips.sWeak: Kafin ƙaddamarwa, ɗaga {{skill}} tare da ɗan gajeren aiki ko takaddun shaida - masu bita suna lura da da'awar ƙwarewar da ba a gama ba.
tips.sRefereeInst: Tambayi alkalin wasa daga {{institution}} wanda ya gan ka jagora, ba wai kawai ya koya maka ba - nau'ikan nau'ikan nau'ikan nau'ikan nau'ikan nau'ikan Chevening suna tasiri akan maki kadai.
tips.sRefereeGeneric: Tabbatar da alkalan wasa guda biyu waɗanda za su iya faɗi wani takamaiman shiri da kuka gudanar - wasiƙun “dalibi mai ƙwazo” maras tushe sun nutsar da bayanan martaba.
tips.sCalendar: Gina kalandar juzu'i na ranar ƙarshe daga "{{deadline}}" tare da ma'auni don kwafi, gwaje-gwaje, da nassoshi.
tips.sOffline: Daftarin yana ba da amsa ba layi ba da farko, sannan liƙa a cikin portal - atomatik-ajiye glitches yana shafe sa'o'i na aiki akan nau'ikan tallafin karatu da yawa.
tips.sAlumni: Bincike 2 tsofaffin ɗalibai daga {{place}} waɗanda suka ci nasara {{source}}; lura da abin da aikace-aikacensu suka jaddada kuma ku kwatanta tsarin, ba labarin ba.
tips.sScore: Idan makin wasan ku ya kasance {{score}}%, bi da giɓi da gaskiya a cikin maƙala - ɓangarorin suna ba da lada ga sanin kai fiye da da'awar kammala.
tips.sHeadline: Daidaita kanun labaran ku ("{{headline}}") tare da manufar shirin don haka allon farko ya riga ya ji da niyya.
tips.sPitch: Shirya filin magana na daƙiƙa 60 na shirin bincikenku don tambayoyi: matsala → gefen ku → {{source}} azaman mai haɓakawa.
tips.sProof: Tattara kayan tarihi na shaida (GitHub, rahotanni, lambobin yabo, haruffan al'umma) waɗanda ke dawo da kowace fasaha da kuka jera - hotunan hotunan da aka shirya kafin amfani.
tips.sEligibility: Bincika kashin ƙasa da komawa gida don {{source}} a kan matsayin ku na {{country}} wannan sake zagayowar - kurakuran cancanta suna lalata kasidu masu ƙarfi.
tips.sBio: Sake rubuta tarihin ku don haka baƙo a cikin {{location}} ya fahimci filin ku a cikin jumla ɗaya, sannan faɗaɗa.
tips.sCheveningCourses: Zaɓi kwasa-kwasan UK guda uku waɗanda suka dace da gaske {{field}}, ba daraja kaɗai ba - Chevening ya ƙi ba da kwas ɗin da ba daidai ba ko da da ƙaƙƙarfan kasidu.
tips.sCheveningNet: Ku ciyar da cikakken shafi akan tsare-tsaren "cibiyar sadarwa": waɗanne ƙungiyoyin jama'ar Burtaniya, dakunan gwaje-gwaje, ko ƙungiyoyin manufofin za ku shiga, da abin da kuke dawo da su zuwa {{place}}.
tips.sDaadFilter: Tace DAAD ta ainihin matakin digirinku da {{field}}, sannan jerin jerin kira guda 2 - aikace-aikacen "Jamus" da kyar suke share yanke na farko.
tips.sDaadLang: Yi yanke shawara da wuri ko kuna buƙatar shaidar Jamusanci ko Ingilishi don shirin mai masaukin baki, kuma ku rubuta ranar gwajin kafin a rufe kiran.
tips.sMastercardApply: Aiwatar ta hanyar jami'ar haɗin gwiwa wanda ke koyar da {{field}} - Masanan Mastercard takamaiman harabar ne, ba nau'i ɗaya na duniya ba.
tips.sMastercardNeed: Rubuta buƙatu da jagoranci tare: sakin layi ɗaya akan shinge, ɗaya akan abin da kuka riga kuka canza ga wasu a cikin {{place}}.
tips.sFulbrightPage: Yi amfani da shafin Fulbright na ƙasarku kawai - ƙayyadaddun ƙayyadaddun ƙayyadaddun ƙididdiga na {{country}} sun bambanta da ƙasidar duniya.
tips.sFulbrightObj: Sanya binciken/binciken ya zama abin karya: wace tambaya a cikin {{field}} zaku amsa cikin watanni 12-24?
tips.sGates: Cambridge Fit ya zo da farko: suna sunan mai kulawa ko ƙungiyar lab masu dacewa da {{field}} kafin goge bayanin Gates.
tips.sTheme: Daura shawarar ku zuwa jigon da aka buga daga {{source}}, ta yin amfani da harshe daga kiran - rashin daidaituwar jigo shine ƙin yarda da shi na kowa.
tips.jResume: Sake rubuta taƙaitaccen bayanin ku don jagora tare da {{skill}} + {{field}}, sannan ku yi madubi saman fi'ili 5 daga kowane {{source}} buɗa muku.
tips.jProof: Gina "takardar hujja" mai shafi 1 tare da harsashi 3: matsala, aiki ta amfani da {{skills}}, sakamako mai aunawa.
tips.jAdvanced: Saka {{skills}} a cikin kashi na farko na uku na LinkedIn/Game da — masu daukar ma'aikata sun yi tsalle, ba sa farauta.
tips.jWeak: Don ayyukan da ke buƙatar {{skill}}, ƙara ƙaramin aikin karshen mako kuma haɗa shi - matsakaicin da'awar ba tare da shaida ba.
tips.jAlerts: Saita faɗakarwar {{source}} don "{{field}}" da ƙasarku ({{country}}), sannan a nemi a cikin awanni 48 na aikawa.
tips.jTarget: Nuna kamfanoni 5 a kowane mako waɗanda ke hayar {{field}} a ciki ko daga {{country}}, ba 50 bazuwar Easy Apply dannawa ba.
tips.jCover: A cikin kowane bayanin rufewa, suna sunan siminti ɗaya wanda za ku aika a cikin kwanaki 30 na farko ta amfani da tarin ku na yanzu.
tips.jReferrals: Nemi masu ba da izini kawai bayan zaku iya bayyana samfurin ƙungiyar a cikin jimloli 2 - sanyi yana tambaya ba tare da gadoji na ƙona aikin gida ba.
tips.jLoom: Yi rikodin Loom na daƙiƙa 90 (ko bayanin murya) yana tafiya ta hanyar aiki; haɗa shi lokacin da {{source}} ya ba da damar saƙo / aika ƙarin.
tips.jConfidence: Amincewar wasanku na yanzu shine ~{{score}}% - idan ƙasa da 70%, ƙarfafa ƙwarewa akan Profile da sake daidaitawa kafin fesa aikace-aikace.
tips.jTranslate: Fassara yaren ilimi daga {{field}} zuwa harshen ma'aikata: "aikin aiki" → "samar da X a ƙarƙashin ranar ƙarshe".
tips.jLog: Ajiye rajistan kin amincewa: rawar, rashin fasaha, aiki na gaba - alamu suna gaya muku abin da za ku koya na gaba da sauri fiye da zato.
tips.jLinkedinOpen: Kunna Buɗe zuwa Aiki (masu daukar ma'aikata kawai) kuma sanya wani aikin da aka nuna wanda ke tabbatar da {{skill}}.
tips.jLinkedinComment: Yi sharhi da tunani a kan guraben aikin haya guda 3 a cikin {{field}} a wannan makon kafin a yi sanyi - ganin dumin gani yana tsit Aiwatar.
tips.jIndeed: Yi amfani da tace wurin Lallai daidai kamar "{{country}}" kuma a tsara ta kwanan wata - abubuwan da ba a taɓa gani ba suna ɓarna makamashi.
tips.jRemoteOk: Karanta layin ƙasa/lokaci sau biyu akan posts Ok Nesa - yawancin ayyukan "na nesa" har yanzu ba a cire {{country}}.
tips.jRemoteRate: Farashin ƙimar ɗan kwangilar ku da yankin lokaci sun zo gaba a saƙon farko don guje wa fatalwa bayan fuska.
tips.jGlassdoor: Karanta sabbin rahotannin hira na wannan ma'aikaci, sannan shirya labarai guda 2 waɗanda ke amsa tsarin tambayar da aka maimaita akai.
tips.jReliefImpact: Aikace-aikacen jagora tare da tasirin filin / aikin sa kai a cikin {{place}} - ReliefWeb yana ɗaukar hayar ma'auni mai nauyi mai dacewa da ƙwarewa.
tips.jReliefLang: Yaren daidaitawa daga guraben aiki (CINDI, kariya, WASH, da dai sauransu) kawai idan za ku iya kare shi - zazzage kalmomi a bayyane yake.
tips.jHeadline: Daidaita kanun labarai na jama'a zuwa "{{headline}}" duk inda kuka shafa don haka {{source}} allo kuma CV ɗinku ya ba da labari ɗaya.
